name: Ziklag
overview: Ziklag was a city originally within the territory of Judah but was later re-allotted to the tribe of Simeon, as noted in Joshua 15:31 and 19:5. It became a significant dwelling place for David when he sought refuge from Saul, with Achish granting him the city to live in (1 Samuel 27:5-6). The city also experienced destruction by the Amalekites, after which David returned there, highlighting its role as a place of both trial and restoration (2 Samuel 1:1). Additionally, Ziklag was a gathering place for David's supporters during his early struggles, and it was inhabited by the returned exiles of Judah, underscoring its continued importance in Israel's history (1 Chronicles 12:1).
